descriptionMarkdown:
This ship is designed to be modular and easy to build
There is a combinator (ontop of rocket production) that decides how much the collects can grab of each:
200 of each asteroid type for the base
+150 of each asteroid type PER extra wing

IMPORTANT: when building extra wings, make sure you are on the "ready for expansion AND when adding the wings, connect the thruster to the ones on top.

NOTE: you can add as many wings as you'd like
NOTE 2: A 1000km/s ship is 5 wings (base included)
NOTE 3: The Mega Version has been made, runs at 1400+km/s. (Also with some belt management improvements and fixes)
title: Lugia - The Wing Ship (1000+km/s)
